html.htmlText: Location, Location, Location. You are in Rua Garrett, the trendiest street in Lisbon! Just walk out from the building into the bustling heart of Chiado, where you can dine, shop and enjoy the best Lisbon has to offer. The apartment is very comfortable with a charming decor and very quiet, even though it's in the middle of everything. The building has two elevators and the apartment has air-conditioning (for cooling and heating). The subway station (Baixa-Chiado) is only 2 min away from the flat!

rules.title: House rules
rules.description: You’ll be staying in someone’s home, so please treat it with care and respect.

content.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
Just few rules ...  :)
1. Please do not smoke inside of the aparment. 
2. Check-in: 16:00 / Check-out: 11:00 AM. Check-in and check-out time can be more flexible, according to your and previous/next guests convenience. After your reservation is confirmed, please provide us the following information:
- airline company, flight number and arrival time on your check-in date
- departure time of your return flight on your check-out date
3. After the reservation is confirmed, we will send you the link to fill out with your ID information. This information is required by Portuguese Law and will be submitted to the Portuguese Immigration Office (SEF). Please fill out this information for all of the guests (including children) before your check-in date.
4. Loosing the key of the apartment implies the payment of 40€. 
5. No parties allowed. This is residential building. Please respect the neighbours as if they were your own.
6. Please turn off the A/C while you are out of the flat and when you check-out.
7. Please do not accumulate the garbage at the flat. There is the garbage box room in the entrance hall of the building. Please dispose the garbage everyday or every 2 days.
